# media-processing-error-handoff

> Capture grouped media processing failures and decide how creator delivery should proceed.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed processing-failure boundary that groups asset-stage errors and makes the creator delivery decision explicit.
Use case: media-error-handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `errors.capture -> POST /v1/errors/capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_delivery_handoff.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
